title: GADVASU notified fourth B.V.Sc. & A.H. counselling on 30 October 2026 alongside Punjab admission updates
description: Review the 30 October 2026 GADVASU fourth B.V.Sc. & A.H. counselling notice and how Punjab veterinary and agriculture applicants verify admission rounds.
summary: GADVASU’s 30 October 2026 notice records the fourth counselling round for B.V.Sc. & A.H. admissions, providing key context for Khalsa College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences and Punjab agricultural institutions.

sections.heading: GADVASU fourth B.V.Sc. & A.H. counselling notice
paragraphs: Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (GADVASU), Ludhiana issued a dated notice on 30 October 2026 regarding the fourth round of B.V.Sc. & A.H. counselling for the 2026–27 academic session. This round governs remaining state and private-college seats under the university’s admission framework.

Applicants targeting [Khalsa College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences](/university/khalsa-college-of-veterinary-and-animal-sciences) in Amritsar must track GADVASU’s official counselling schedule, category cutoffs, and VCI-recognised seat categories.

sections.heading: Separating veterinary counselling from Punjab B.Sc. Agriculture routes
paragraphs: In Punjab, veterinary admissions (B.V.Sc. & A.H.) operate through GADVASU and NEET-UG / university merit lists, whereas B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture admissions at [Khalsa College, Amritsar](/university/khalsa-college-amritsar), [Chandigarh University](/university/chandigarh-university), [Lovely Professional University](/university/lovely-professional-university) and [Guru Kashi University](/university/guru-kashi-university) follow each institution’s or affiliating university’s separate admission schedule.

Compare programme-level eligibility in [B.Sc. Agriculture eligibility: subjects and admission routes](/articles/bsc-agriculture-eligibility) and check ICAR unit accreditation in [how to check ICAR accreditation](/articles/icar-accreditation-how-to-check).

faqs.question: Does GADVASU counselling cover B.Sc. Agriculture at private universities in Punjab?
faqs.answer: No. GADVASU counselling covers veterinary, dairy and fisheries programmes under its jurisdiction, including affiliated colleges like Khalsa College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences. Private universities conduct separate agriculture admissions.

faqs.question: Where should I verify vacant seats before attending a late counselling round?
faqs.answer: Always check the latest category-wise vacancy notification on the official GADVASU admissions portal before paying counselling or reporting fees.
